trainFunc.description: Name for the function on the native model to call to do {@link MlTrainable#train}.

keepInputColumnIndices.description:
Flag denoting whether to maintain column indices between the inputs and outputs of this pipe. If this flag is
true, and the input and output column size don't match, then the unchanged output will be returned from
{@link SklearnPipe#process}.
